notes.title: Graphics update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Quite some graphics and effects were replaced with better animations and images
[*] One gameplay change: Players can now again have minus points. This prevents players with 0 points to suicide and get full health with that.
[*] Other than that just minor changes and fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Update - Controller issues fixed
notes.content:
[h2]Some mentioned controller problems have been fixed[/h2]
- there was a problem with the controller-configuration which had to be removed for the while being - you control per default layout now. (You might need to configure your controllers in the Steam controller settings.)

- other than that small changes and fixes like for example minor teamplay-damage issues and small graphical and gameplay details.

notes.title: Update 3.10.1
notes.content: Fixed some minor bugs resulting from the port to the latest Unity version.

notes.title: Update to latest Unity version
notes.content: Manic Archers was updated to the latest Unity version which means it should run faster and more stable on most machines.

notes.title: Windows Update - Bugfix
notes.content:
This update fixes a bug which made the game crash under certain circumstances when using X-Box controllers (or compatibles) in the Windows version.

The crashes were happening often and are fixed with this update.

notes.title: Fixes - 3.9.3
notes.content:
This update contains bug-fixes:
[list]
[*] Many potential causes for crashes have been fixed, Manic Archers should run much more stable now
[*] Issues with sound volume settings were fixed, attract videos and some single sounds now play at the correct volume
[/list]

notes.title: Small fix
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed ice spikes freezing the owner
[*] Reduced wolf health so the powerup becomes less dominant
[/list]

notes.title: Big update - performance etc.
notes.content:
First big update after release - major performance improvement
[list]
[*] Some powerups now cause a much higher combo count
[*] Ultra health mode - this mode is lifting Manic Archers out of the one-hit-kill zone
[*] Beginner mode with only 5 powerups - this mode changes gameplay drastically
[*] The amount of health is now configurable in settings
[*] Slowmotion is also configurable in settings
[*] Arrows stuck in dead player can now be collected
[*] Framerate for animations has been raised, making the game much more fluid
[*] Projectiles now have an actual height and go farther when shot while jumping
[*] Projectiles can now hit other projectiles and will deflect
[*] Several new sprites
[*] More decals
[*] Sudden death is gone
[*] Stability fixes and many more improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3.8.14 - Fixes for crashes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] A lot of reasons for crashes have been routed out after long-term testing
[*] Controllers being plugged in or out during the game should be fine now
[*] Bonus: Big catapult arrows now stay on the field and are destroyable
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3.8.13
notes.content:
Fixes of several bugs surfacing after long-term testing which occasionally could lead to crashes.
The game should be much more stable now especially in matches over several hours.

notes.title: Update 3.8.10
notes.content:
Fixing the last fixes... should be final by now.
[list]
[*] Especially updated the combo-system and display
[*] Powerups are now only collectible when on ground
[*] Fixed powerups not disappearing on collection in some cases
[*] Many more fixes & improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Update 3.8.6 - final on probation

[*] Added attract mode videos to the intro screen
[*] Many smaller fixes & improvements
[/list]

[*] Tendrils can now catch fire

notes.title: Update 3.8.1 - Player portraits
notes.content:
[list]

Basically the game is now finished to 95%. Additions will be non-breaking i.e. more maps, small bug fixes and other improvements but that is about it.

notes.title: Big overhaul - almost completed
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Generally to many improvements to list
[*] Fixed a nasty bug which resulted in laggy/sluggish movement/shooting
[*] New map selection involving a world map
[*] Fists are now tendrils
[*] New map "Cloud Pass"
[*] Dashing while dashing now ends the dash
[*] You can now dash while being tossed
[*] New animations everywhere
[*] Enemies now indicate player detection
[*] You cannot ice yourself anymore with the frost arrows
[*] Fireball super is now faster but also stepped in movement
[*] Catapult arrows now have a short warm up phase
[*] Warnings on the ground are now additionally indicated by white circles
[*] New shock arrows super with a small lightning explosion
[*] Super ray can now be upgraded with triple shot arrows
[*] Game should be faster overall due to many efficiency improvements
[*] Players now toss through breakable objects if fast enough and the object shatters
[*] Many small quality improvements in graphics and presentation
[*] Many fixes and improvements
[/list]

By now we are nearing completion, basically it is just a very few things that are left to check and improve and the box art to do - maybe there will be some more maps as well. But basically the gameplay is almost done.
